description: Delphi queues client-visible SM_STRUCK with 200ms delay for main-target hits and 500ms delay for secondary DirectAttack sword-skill hits; monster targets also receive an immediate internal RM_STRUCK AI message.

delphi_source.main_monster_internal_immediate: ObjBase.pas:5542 targ.SendMsg(targ, RM_STRUCK, ...) for non-human AI reaction
delphi_source.directattack_monster_internal_immediate: ObjBase.pas:5264-5265 target.SendMsg(target, RM_STRUCK, ...) for non-human AI reaction

stages.note: Immediate SendMsg at ObjBase.pas:5542 feeds monster RunMsg/AI state; it is not the client-visible SM_STRUCK packet.
Immediate SendMsg at ObjBase.pas:5264-5265 feeds monster RunMsg/AI state for secondary sword-skill hits.

stages.rule: SM_HIT/skill action remains visible immediately; main-target SM_STRUCK is delayed 200ms, secondary DirectAttack SM_STRUCK is delayed 500ms. Monster AI may react internally before either visible struck packet.

cplusplus_mapping.current_risk: Frame-end queueing may collapse the 200ms main-target and 500ms DirectAttack visible struck delays unless PR2/PR9 preserve them explicitly.
